UDPpacket

UDPpacket :: struct {
	channel: i32,
	// The src/dst channel of the packet 
	data:    [^]u8,
	// The packet data 
	len:     i32,
	// The length of the packet data 
	maxlen:  i32,
	// The size of the data buffer 
	status:  i32,
	// packet status after sending 
	address: IPaddress,
}
